iriarte2025.DFT_interpretation: Energies between relaxed initial/product structures are reaction energies. They are not transition-state activation barriers and do not supply Cp(T), absolute entropy or a complete metakaolin free energy.
iriarte2025.cross_rate_review_definition: Select Figure 6 parameters from 3 C/min without project refitting. For each Figure 4 curve, supply its measured alpha=0.1 temperature as initial condition and review subsequent alpha=0.2 through 0.9. Other heating-rate points are not used to tune parameters. This is within-study conditional transfer, not a fully blind material qualification or prediction of onset.

izadifar2020.DFT_limits: Finite candidate structural models; F is approximated by electronic energy assuming similar entropy contributions. Water grand-potential transitions do not constitute a measured absolute solid Cp/H/S closure or kinetic barriers.
open_source_questions: Methods state heating to 1100 C while Figure 3 and later recrystallization discussion include about 1400 C; thermal history of those measurements needs clarification before a combined temperature program is assigned.

Figure 4 caption uses theoretical 13.95% stoichiometric mass loss and curves reach 100%; text gives about 13.25% for impure kaolinite samples. Whether mineral-content normalization was applied is not specified clearly enough for this project to equate all these conversion definitions.
These are different specimens from KGa-1 and SRB in the 2025 study. Their observations cannot be used as a same-material holdout.
